name: NitroOpenapiPublish
description: Publishes OpenAPI documents to the Nitro registry.
author: ChilliCream

inputs.name: tag
inputs.label: Tag
inputs.helpMarkDown: The tag of the OpenAPI collection version.

inputs.name: openapiCollectionId
inputs.label: OpenAPI collection ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: The ID of the OpenAPI collection.

inputs.name: apiKey
inputs.label: API key
inputs.helpMarkDown: API key for authentication. Use a secret pipeline variable: `$(NITRO_API_KEY)`.

inputs.name: force
inputs.label: Force
inputs.helpMarkDown: Continue publishing even if breaking changes or validation errors are detected.

inputs.name: waitForApproval
inputs.label: Wait for approval
inputs.helpMarkDown: Require approval in the Nitro UI to continue publishing when breaking changes or validation errors are detected.

inputs.name: cloudUrl
inputs.label: Cloud URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: The URL of the Nitro registry.
